verdict.rationale: Sierra ships several built-in AI assistants that take delegated work. Ghostwriter builds or modifies agents from natural-language prompts and uploaded SOPs, transcripts or audio. Explorer answers natural-language questions across thousands of conversations and sends proactive weekly briefings. Agent Studio can AI-generate journeys from existing procedures, and Live Assist guides reps and starts workflows from inside a conversation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Ghostwriter and Explorer, and in-depth docs on the assistants' limits and task scope beyond marketing-page claims.
